submission.causalMechanism: The conclusion correction control path builds a Tool bound-state payload (passes non-empty `observations` and/or `seen_tool_call_ids` to `bind_run_state`). Loop.py, after appending the correction feedback message (loop.py:2157-2174), calls `bind_run_state()` (loop.py:2188) carrying that Tool observational state. On a no-Tool Agent Run, SQLiteHarnessAgentBridge.bind_run_state (sqlite_agent_bridge.py:120) checks `if observations or seen_tool_call_ids:` and raises `ToolBridgeError` (kind PROTOCOL_INVALID) with the message at line 122, because a no-Tool run must not bind Tool observations or Tool Call identities. Loop.py catches this ToolBridgeError at line 2189-2193 and terminates with `RUNTIME_UNKNOWN` (str of the error). The causal interaction is the launch of Tool-bound state binding from the conclusion-correction control path onto a boundary whose Contract explicitly forbids Tool observations/Tool Call identities.
submission.hypothesis: A real no-Tool Agent Run (one whose Contract encodes a no-Tool surface with an empty tool catalog/grant) entered the harness conclusion-correction control path in loop.py (lines 2132-2146) and failed at sqlite_agent_bridge.py:120-122 when bind_run_state() observed that the correction control path was recording Tool observations / seen Tool Call identities onto the no-Tool run.
submission.nextFalsifier: Run the same real no-Tool adapter through the conclusion-correction path with a bridge variant that strips `observations`/`seen_tool_call_ids` (or passes empty tuples) into bind_run_state; if the run then completes or continues without ToolBridgeError, the causal mechanism is confirmed as the conclusion-control path forwarding Tool-bound state into the no-Tool bridge. Conversely, if the error still occurs at bind_run_state with empty observations/seen_tool_call_ids, the mechanism must be revised.
